geographic_unit.inclusion: Only whole grid cells covered by the pre-existing study window; freeze unit geometry and hash before outcome sampling
geographic_unit.administrative_identity: Public research window, not a certified current or historical district boundary

flood_occurrence: At least one independently confirmed contiguous patch of temporary inundation covering at least 2500 square metres of previously non-permanent-water land inside the fixed cell during the target interval
threshold_review: 2500 square metres is a proposed operational definition, not a validated sensor detection limit; local sensitivity and permanent-water baselines require independent scientific approval
scope_limit: Floods below the proposed mapping threshold, under vegetation or buildings, and narrow urban drainage flooding may be unobservable; this pilot is not a validated all-flood Karnataka service
positive: Independent observed inundation and validated permanence/quality/geometry with exact observation time within the interval, sufficient to meet the proposed patch threshold; candidate-group/event identity separately adjudicated
negative: Independent, quality-reviewed observation process covers the same complete cell throughout the entire interval, capable of detecting the target patch, and verifies its absence throughout; discrete dry acquisitions alone are insufficient
unknown: Any unresolved location, time, source independence, detection limit, partial coverage, permanence, rights, or review; no news silence or missing observation becomes a negative
required_observations: Original source bytes and checksum, independent reference and provenance
Categorical temporary/permanent/dry/unknown coverage and spatial registration uncertainty
Exact acquisition timestamps and observation validity; issue dates and multi-day composites are not acquisition timestamps
Patch area/contiguity evidence, permanence baseline and independently validated local detection performance
Separately supplied scientific review receipt bound to protocol, source, cell geometry, interval and interpretation
secondary_acquisition_target: Temporary inundation at a predeclared actual future acquisition, issued 24 hours before its scheduled time; separate protocol approval needed. Acquisition classification alone is not future prediction or daily absence
independent_evaluation: Hold out independently adjudicated physical events, spatial regions and later time blocks; unresolved group relationships cannot be declared independent examples or split across training and evaluation

Archive forecast runs, publication/availability receipts and antecedent feature windows available by issue time; delayed reanalysis and contemporaneous satellite outcomes cannot act as future predictors
Report event-level and unit-level sensitivity, precision, calibration and uncertainty against independently observed outcomes and simple baselines
Assess observation selection bias, missingness, geography transfer and seasonal coverage; sample-size/power and class coverage require external scientific review
No model fit until target, positive/negative evidence, rights and evaluation design receive independent scientific approval
